answer: Put cross-chain identity proof via Owlto at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 679 aliases need 679 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. Trust the crystal of the check, count the raven of the cost, and read the plume of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
